questions.stem: Explain why floating-point arithmetic can lead to rounding errors. Provide an example to illustrate your explanation.
markingGuide: Explanation of finite precision in floating-point representation.
Discussion of binary approximation of decimal fractions.
Example illustrating a rounding error in computation.
questions.explanation: Floating-point arithmetic can lead to rounding errors because of the finite number of bits available to represent numbers. Many decimal fractions cannot be represented exactly in binary, leading to small errors. For example, adding 0.1 and 0.2 results in a binary sum that is slightly off from 0.3 due to these approximations.
